This file is a representative, explicitly incomplete slice of the 134-case frozen registry (registry-ids.v1.json) -- it proves the per-case decision-sequence mechanism, the delegate-to-default mechanism, and all 6 fault types named in the CHAOS-3219 issue. Phase 2 Lane 2b case authors add more entries here as they author tests/acceptance/world/ask-dev-world.v1/corpus/case-*.json; an id present in registry-ids.v1.json but absent from this file's 'cases' fails loud (case_not_scripted) rather than silently passing, so under-coverage is always visible, never masked.
